Title: Complete booking status
Description: A booking may be marked complete after all checklist items and required photos are submitted.

Title: Reopen completed booking
Description: Only administrators may reopen a completed booking after entering a required audit note.

Title: Supervisor permissions
Description: Supervisors can reassign contractors in their region but cannot reopen completed bookings.

Title: Administrator reopen permission
Description: Administrators may reopen completed bookings when an audit note is provided.

Title: Create booking
Description: Dispatchers create a booking with customer address schedule window and job type.

Title: Update schedule window
Description: Dispatchers can update the schedule window before a contractor accepts the job.

Title: Complete checklist
Description: Contractors must complete the job checklist before submitting completion.

Title: Reassign contractor
Description: Supervisors can reassign an open booking to a different contractor when the new contractor has matching skills.

Title: Add completion photo
Description: Contractors upload at least one completion photo before completing a booking.

Title: View booking timeline
Description: Users can view status changes schedule changes reassignment events and reopen audit notes on a booking timeline.

Title: Contractor availability
Description: Contractors can mark availability by day and region.

Title: Contractor skill match
Description: Bookings show eligible contractors based on required skill region and current availability.

Title: Schedule conflict warning
Description: Radar warns dispatchers when a booking schedule overlaps an assigned contractor commitment.

Title: Same day priority
Description: Same day emergency bookings appear at the top of the schedule queue.

Title: Checklist template
Description: Administrators configure checklist templates by job type.

Title: Required checklist answers
Description: Required checklist questions block completion until answered.

Title: Photo metadata
Description: Uploaded photos store timestamp contractor booking identifier and GPS availability when provided.

Title: Photo review
Description: Supervisors can review completion photos before invoice approval.

Title: Booking creation fields
Description: Given a dispatcher creates a booking then address schedule window and job type are required.

Title: Reassignment action
Description: Given a supervisor views an open booking then the reassign contractor action is available only for eligible contractors.

Title: Reopen button
Description: Given an administrator views a completed booking then a reopen action is visible and requires an audit note.

Title: Schedule conflict copy
Description: Given a dispatcher selects a conflicting schedule then a conflict warning names the contractor commitment.

Title: Checklist completion block
Description: Given required checklist answers are missing then the complete booking button is disabled.

Title: Completion photo required
Description: Given a booking requires photos then completion is blocked until a photo is uploaded.

Title: Reopen audit trail
Description: What audit note fields are required when an administrator reopens a completed booking?

Title: Contractor timezone
Description: Should contractor availability use contractor timezone or dispatcher timezone?

Title: Timeline retention
Description: How long should booking timeline events and reopen audit notes remain visible to support users?

Title: Admin audit reporting
Description: Do administrators need a monthly report of reopened bookings?

Title: Create booking happy path
Description: Verify dispatcher can create a booking with required fields and sees it in the queue.

Title: Timeline shows reassignment and reopen
Description: Verify booking timeline includes reassignment schedule changes and reopen audit notes.

Title: Supervisor reassigns booking
Description: Verify supervisor can reassign an open booking to an eligible contractor with matching skills.

Title: Administrator reopens completed booking
Description: Verify administrator can reopen a completed booking only after entering an audit note.

Title: Schedule conflict warning
Description: Verify overlapping schedule assignment shows a conflict warning.

Title: Emergency booking priority
Description: Verify same day emergency booking appears above normal priority work.

Title: Required checklist block
Description: Verify completion is blocked until required checklist questions are answered.

Title: Photo required to complete
Description: Verify completion is blocked until a photo is uploaded for photo-required job types and metadata is stored.

Title: Contractor availability by region
Description: Verify contractor availability can be entered by day and region.

Title: Skill match and availability filter
Description: Verify booking assignment lists only contractors with matching skill region and availability.
